title: Joyedcombat
description: JoyedCombat is a customizable combat-tag plugin that tracks players individually, prevents combat logging
body:
![Joyedcombat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af9fcf2eaee1f4ee7150283f5f3db591818bd085.png)

JoyedCombat is a customizable combat-tag plugin that tracks players individually, prevents combat logging

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f911d0fff25cc2ababbeb9455e7c89d0d37bd63c.png)

- Combat tagged, when you punch a player they get combat tagged for a set amount of seconds
- multiple commands on combat log. you can set as many commands you want when they leave while combat tagged
- Blocked Commands. You can set any command to be used while in combat.
- Customize the prefix

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f57a92a0a95332c07525ce5b33e34d98471aaf96.png)


```
/combatadmin reload
```


```
/combatadmin time [time]
```
```
/combatadmin glowing [on/off]
```

```
/combatadmin mode [actionbar,bossbar,both]
```

```
/combatadmin fight [player1] [player2]
```


```
/combatadmin leavecommand 
[add/remove] [command without /]
```
